name: Finding the Age Books
hint_layers: Myst Island is the hub; most major mechanisms point toward access to another Age.
Read books and environmental clues before forcing mechanisms.
If a device changes the environment, check whether it opened a path to a linking book.
solution: Explore Myst Island, solve its mechanisms, and use the revealed linking books to enter the Ages.

name: Collecting Pages Across Ages
hint_layers: Each Age is self-contained and has its own logic chain.
Look for readable journals and environmental clues before searching for pages.
Return pages to the corresponding books only when you understand the consequence.
solution: Visit each Age, solve its logical puzzle sequence, retrieve red or blue pages, and return them to Myst Island.

name: Final Book Choice
hint_layers: Do not trust every imprisoned voice equally.
The red and blue books are not the only important books in the library.
The green book route matters for the best outcome.
solution: Avoid freeing Sirrus or Achenar; use the green book path and bring Atrus the missing page to reach the favorable ending.
